verdicts.quote: Status: ready-for-agent. Implementation is blocked until ADR-0004 is accepted (see Further Notes, item 1).
verdicts.reason: The spec marks the atomic-write dependency as waiting for ADR-0004's acceptance, and the final message says implementation is blocked because ADR-0004 is still proposed.
The spec goes straight from Implementation Decisions to Testing Decisions with no Quality Requirements section, and it never names a QS-n scenario.
